denial_letter:
NOTICE OF ADVERSE BENEFIT DETERMINATION

Date of Notice: February 3, 2022
Claim: Home health aide services, 20 visits, January 2022
Reason Code: CO-B7

Benefits are not available for the submitted services. The services
described in the submitted documentation consist of assistance with
bathing, dressing, and meal preparation. Section 4.1 of your Certificate
excludes Custodial Care. Custodial Care is defined at Section 1.4.

You may request an internal appeal within 180 days.
denial_reason: Benefits are not available for the submitted services.

sub_claims.text: The services described in the submitted documentation consist of assistance with bathing, dressing, and meal preparation.
sub_claims.rationale: The policy explicitly states in Section 4.1 that this plan does not provide benefits for Custodial Care, regardless of where the care is furnished or who furnishes it. This directly contradicts the sub-claim that the services described consist of assistance with bathing, dressing, and meal preparation, which are defined as Custodial Care under Section 1.4.

nurse.
